latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Instagram Video Editor AI Free.

- Instantly edit and export Instagram-ready videos (Reels & Stories) with support for MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automatic cloud GPU processing: uploads, edits, and exports take 30-60 seconds; outputs high-quality 1080p MP4 files.
- Seamless integration with NEMO cloud backend, including free token setup and session management.
- Supports common editing tasks: trimming, captions, aspect ratio adjustment, adding text overlays, and background music.
- Simple chat interface: just upload clips and describe your desired edits; matches user prompts to editing actions automatically.
- Transparent status updates, error handling, and credits checking for a smooth user experience.
